meta.name: The Ed Sullivan Show
meta.description:
For over 20 years, Americans spent their Sunday nights with Ed Sullivan. Now you can flashback to the best musical acts, stand-up comedians, and variety performers from the legendary program. It’s a really big show, 24 hours a day.

Shows: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show, Ed Sullivan's Rock 'n' Roll Classics, Comedy Legends from The Ed Sullivan Show, The Ed Sullivan Show: Sports Heroes, The Very Best of the Ed Sullivan Show
Available on: The Roku Channel, Plex
